items.question: What is pemberian pinjaman wang dalam talian (e-Lending)?
items.answer: Money lending conducted online. Borrowers apply, verify their identity, sign and repay through your website or mobile app instead of walking into your branch. KPKT treats it as a distinct way of operating, governed by the Online Moneylenders Guidelines, so it carries its own approval rather than being covered automatically by a traditional licence.

items.question: How long does an online money lending licence take?
items.answer: About three months from kickoff to nationwide go-live, in our experience: two weeks for the provisional dossier and KPKT presentation, six weeks to build and configure the platform, two weeks of testing and review preparation, and two weeks through final inspection and approval. Real timing depends on your readiness and KPKT scheduling.

items.question: Do existing PPW holders need kebenaran tambahan for e-Lending?
items.answer: Holding a money lending licence does not by itself permit you to lend online. Existing PPW holders seek additional permission — kebenaran tambahan — to transact online, and have to show KPKT that the platform, signing controls and data handling meet the Online Moneylenders Guidelines. We prepare that application together with the platform evidence that supports it, and confirm the current requirement for your licence class in the consultation.

items.question: What is TrueKredit™ Pro?
items.answer: The digital tier of our loan management system. Standard runs your loan book: borrowers, schedules, repayments and KPKT paperwork. Pro adds nationwide borrower channels — a branded website plus iPhone and Android apps — digital signing kept under your control, live and video attestation, and the reporting an online licence review asks for. Existing Standard users upgrade without moving the loan book.

items.question: What does Truestack handle end-to-end?
items.answer: Licensing strategy, the provisional dossier, presentation support at KPKT, the platform build on TrueKredit™ Pro, deployment to your own secure cloud in Malaysia, testing, an independent security review, the review pack, accompaniment through final inspection, and ongoing KPKT compliance support after launch. One team, one contract.

items.question: Is this licensing advice only, or do you deliver the software too?
items.answer: Both, and we prefer to do both. Advice without a platform leaves you holding an approval you cannot operate on, and a platform without licensing support risks choices that stall your review. We take responsibility for the licence path and the software under a single contract.

items.question: Who builds KPKT digital lending platforms in Malaysia?
items.answer: Truestack Technologies Sdn. Bhd., a Kuala Lumpur software and consultancy company working exclusively with Malaysian lenders and fintechs. Licensed money lenders including ezdana, PinjoCep, Proficient Premium, Andas Capital and CreditXpress run on our platforms.

items.question: Do you also handle the Shariah digital licence, or only conventional PPW?
items.answer: Both. The conventional path on this page is kebenaran tambahan for e-Lending on an existing lesen PPW, with the book on TrueKredit™ Pro. Shariah digital lending is a separate upcoming KPKT approval: its own legal entity, a Shariah advisor or committee, approved contracts, and a platform that evidences Tawarruq, Ta'widh and Gharamah. That path is TrueSyariah™ — see truestack.my/truesyariah. The two licences cannot sit in the same operating company.
